children.name: Lophiocarpus dinteri Engl.
children.description: The native range of this species is Botswana to Namibia. It is a annual and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Lophiocarpus latifolius Nowicke
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Mozambique to KwaZulu-Natal, Namibia. It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Lophiocarpus polystachyus Turcz.
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Africa. It is a perennial or subshrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Lophiocarpus tenuissimus Hook.fil.
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Zambia to S. Africa. It is a perennial or subshrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.
